column2: A small machine filters the tap water before it reaches our glasses.
column3: 一台小機器會在自來水流進我們杯子之前先過濾。
column4: filter the water (過濾水)
column5: filter 像「飛兒他」：水飛過小洞，兒子他留下渣滓

column2: The old paint on the fence began to flake in the summer sun.
column3: 圍籬上的舊油漆在夏天的太陽下開始一片片剝落。
column4: paint begins to flake (油漆開始剝落)
column5: flake 是薄片，像雪花 snowflake，掉下來一片片

column2: The duck flapped its wings and splashed across the pond.
column3: 鴨子拍動翅膀，水花四濺地划過池塘。
column4: flap its wings (拍動翅膀)
column5: flap 唸起來像「福來」：翅膀啪啪啪拍動的聲音

column2: A bat flicked past the window, and Lily jumped in surprise.
column3: 一隻蝙蝠從窗邊掠過，莉莉嚇了一跳。
column4: flick past the window (從窗邊掠過)
column5: flick 像「福力克」：一閃就過，快得來不及看

column2: We flipped a coin to decide who would go first.
column3: 我們擲硬幣決定誰先上場。
column4: flip a coin (擲硬幣)
column5: flip 像「福力普」：硬幣啪地翻轉，就是擲

column2: Please format your essay with a title, an introduction, and three paragraphs.
column3: 請把你的作文編排成有標題、前言和三個段落的格式。
column4: format a document (編排文件格式)
column5: format 就是 form 形式 + mat：把內容排成固定形狀

column2: Dad fumed when he found out someone had scratched his new car.
column3: 爸爸發現有人刮傷他的新車時氣得冒煙。
column4: fume with anger (氣得發火)
column5: fume 是煙霧；氣到頭頂冒煙，就是發怒

column2: The electrician fused the two wires together so the lamp would work again.
column3: 電工把兩條電線熔接在一起，燈就能再亮了。
column4: fuse two wires (熔接兩條電線)
column5: fuse 像「福玉子」：兩個東西熔成一個

column2: Stop fussing over small details and just start your drawing.
column3: 別再為小細節忙亂煩惱了，直接開始畫吧。
column4: fuss over details (為細節大驚小怪)
column5: fuss 像「發屎」：為小事發出一大堆聲響

column2: Wild horses galloped across the open field at sunrise.
column3: 野馬在日出時分奔馳過開闊的原野。
column4: gallop across a field (奔馳過原野)
column5: gallop 像「該洛普」：馬蹄一直「蓋落」地面疾跑

column2: She gasped when she saw the huge cake waiting on the table.
column3: 她看見桌上擺著巨大的蛋糕，驚訝地倒抽一口氣。
column4: gasp for air (喘著氣)
column5: gasp 像「該是 P」：嚇一跳，倒抽一口氣的聲音

column2: The teacher glared at the noisy boys until they went quiet.
column3: 老師怒目瞪著吵鬧的男孩們，直到他們安靜下來。
column4: glare at someone (怒瞪某人)
column5: glare 像「鬼來」：兇狠瞪人，目光像強光

column2: A small light gleamed at the end of the dark tunnel.
column3: 黑暗隧道的盡頭有一點微光在閃爍。
column4: a light gleams (燈光微微閃亮)
column5: gleam 像「葛林」：綠光微微發亮

column2: Frost glittered on the grass like thousands of tiny jewels.
column3: 草地上的霜閃閃發亮，像成千上萬顆小寶石。
column4: eyes glitter with joy (眼睛因喜悅而閃亮)
column5: glitter 像「葛利特」：亮晶晶的碎亮片

column2: The sky gloomed over, and soon heavy rain began to fall.
column3: 天空漸漸變得陰沉，很快就下起大雨。
column4: the sky gloom over (天色轉為陰暗)
column5: gloom 像「古路」：古老的路上陰陰暗暗，心情也低落

column2: The puppy gnawed on my slipper while we were away.
column3: 我們不在的時候，小狗一直啃著我的拖鞋。
column4: gnaw on a bone (啃骨頭)
column5: gnaw 的 g 不發音，唸起來像「諾」：狗狗諾諾地啃

column2: The twins gobbled their breakfast and ran to catch the bus.
column3: 雙胞胎狼吞虎嚥地吃完早餐，跑去趕公車。
column4: gobble up food (狼吞虎嚥地吃)
column5: gobble 像火雞叫「咕嚕咕嚕」，大口吃東西

column2: Cows grazed quietly on the green hill behind the farm.
column3: 乳牛安靜地在農場後方的綠色山丘上吃草。
column4: cattle graze on grass (牛群吃草)
column5: graze 像「葛雷」：灰灰的牛慢慢啃草

column2: Mom greased the baking pan so the cake would not stick.
column3: 媽媽在烤盤上抹了油，蛋糕才不會黏住。
column4: grease a pan (在鍋盤上塗油)
column5: grease 像「Grease 咯瑞斯」：油滑滑，手一直滑掉

column2: The climber gripped the rope tightly with both hands.
column3: 登山者用雙手緊緊抓住繩子。
column4: grip a rope tightly (緊握繩子)
column5: grip 像「GRIP 咕力」：咕地一聲握緊，不放手

column2: The boys groaned when the teacher announced a surprise test.
column3: 老師宣布突擊考試時，男孩們都發出哀嘆。
column4: groan with pain (痛得呻吟)
column5: groan 像「葛弄」：被弄痛了就哀號

column2: The dog growled softly when a stranger came near the gate.
column3: 陌生人走近大門時，狗低聲嗥叫起來。
column4: growl at strangers (對陌生人低吼)
column5: growl 像「G 奧」：喉嚨裡發出「呼嚕」的低吼聲

column2: The workers grumbled about the long meeting but stayed until the end.
column3: 員工們抱怨會議太長，不過還是待到最後。
column4: grumble about work (抱怨工作)
column5: grumble 像「果然不」：嘴裡小聲碎念不滿

column2: He gulped down a glass of cold water after the long run.
column3: 長跑之後，他一口氣灌下一大杯冰水。
column4: gulp down water (大口灌水)
column5: gulp 像「咕噗」：喝水咕嚕一口吞下去

column2: The wind gusted all night, shaking the windows of our small cabin.
column3: 風整夜強勁地吹，把我們小木屋的窗戶震得搖晃。
column4: the wind gusts (風猛吹)
column5: gust 像「嘎斯」：一陣風嘎地吹來

column2: The cook gutted the fish and rinsed it under cold water.
column3: 廚師把魚的內臟取出來，並用冷水沖洗乾淨。
column4: gut a fish (取出魚的內臟)
column5: gut 是肚腸；動詞就是把肚子裡的東西清掉

column2: A broken leg would handicap the runner in the final race.
column3: 斷腿會讓那位跑者在決賽中處於不利。
column4: handicap a runner (使跑者處於劣勢)
column5: hand + in + cap：手伸進帽子裡抽籤，運氣差就吃虧

column2: Farmers harnessed the horses to the wagon before dawn.
column3: 農夫們在黎明前把馬套上馬車。
column4: harness a horse (給馬上挽具)
column5: harness 像「哈你死」：套住馬，讓牠好好拉車

column2: Two strong men hauled the heavy boat up onto the beach.
column3: 兩名壯漢把沉重的船拖上海灘。
column4: haul a heavy load (拖運重物)
column5: haul 像「厚」：東西很厚重，要用力拖走

column2: People say a ghost haunts the old house at the end of the street.
column3: 人們說有鬼魂常出沒於街尾那棟老房子。
column4: haunt an old house (常出沒於老房子)
column5: haunt 像「很 on 特」：很愛來，一直常去，像鬼魂

column2: The driver did not heed the warning sign and drove into the flood.
column3: 司機沒有留意警告標誌，直接開進了積水。
column4: heed a warning (留意警告)
column5: heed 像「嘿的」：嘿，留意聽的，就是heed

column2: Good lighting can heighten the mood of a romantic dinner.
column3: 好的燈光可以提升浪漫晚餐的氣氛。
column4: heighten the tension (加劇緊張)
column5: height 高度 + en 使：讓某個程度變高

column2: Church bells heralded the start of the new year across the town.
column3: 教堂鐘聲在整個小鎮宣告新年的來臨。
column4: herald a new era (預示新時代來臨)
column5: herald 像「嘿囉」：傳令官喊嘿囉，通報消息

column2: Armed men hijacked the bus and forced the driver to change direction.
column3: 武裝男子劫持了公車，並強迫司機改變方向。
column4: hijack a plane (劫機)
column5: hijack 像「害架」：害人的劫持行為，很危險

column2: The cat hissed at the dog and ran up the tree.
column3: 貓對著狗發出嘶嘶聲，然後爬上樹。
column4: a snake hisses (蛇發出嘶嘶聲)
column5: hiss 的聲音本身就是「嘶」，像蛇吐氣

column2: Drivers honked their horns as the traffic stopped moving.
column3: 車流停止前進時，駕駛人紛紛按喇叭。
column4: honk the horn (按喇叭)
column5: honk 像「紅客」：紅燈不動，後面客人一直按喇叭

column2: Mom hooded the baby with a soft blue cap to keep out the cold wind.
column3: 媽媽替寶寶罩上柔軟的藍色帽子來擋住冷風。
column4: hood a child (替孩子罩上帽子)
column5: hood 像「虎」：像小紅帽的帽子罩著頭

column2: Reporters hounded the actor for days after the scandal.
column3: 醜聞爆發後的好幾天，記者們一直緊追著那位演員。
column4: hound a celebrity (緊追名人)
column5: hound 是獵犬，獵犬緊追獵物不放，就是 hound

column2: A helicopter hovered above the flooded area, looking for survivors.
column3: 一架直升機盤旋在淹水區域上空，尋找生還者。
column4: hover above the ground (在地面上方盤旋)
column5: hover 像「好喔」：蜂鳥在花旁一直「好喔、好喔」停在空中

column2: Wolves howled at the moon on the mountain all night.
column3: 狼在山上對著月亮整夜嗥叫。
column4: howl at the moon (對著月亮嗥叫)
column5: howl 像「號」：狼長長地號叫
